explanation: The statement concerns the library's own definitions (PermutationTriple.mapMonodromy and monodromyGroup, the closure of σ0 and σ1). Mathlib has no declaration about these. The proof uses generic Mathlib facts (MonoidHom.map_closure, MonoidHom.range_eq_map, Subgroup.map_subtype_inj) together with library lemmas such as closure_pair_eq_monodromyGroup. It also needs the auxiliary generation fact hgen, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation of a single Mathlib result. I did not run searches in the Mathlib directories; I judged this from the proof and the statement.
